name: iter4-report
title: Auditron Extended Local SDK Validation — CrowdStrike Racing About
stage: Test — Extended Build and Integration Validation
summary: Human-authorized extension consumed two additional Maven calls. Package/unit and integration reports pass, but live Author rendering fails because the core bundle is **Installed**, not Active; HTL cannot resolve the custom header/footer Sling Models.

matrix.detail: All-package ZIP 7,661,144 bytes; 8 Surefire tests pass; captured process exit/log unavailable
Failsafe 5 tests, 0 failures/errors using local profile
HTTP 200 but zero custom header/footer DOM nodes; HTL model-resolution exception

findings.component: adlc-crowdstrike.core bundle / site header and footer
findings.title: Core bundle is Installed rather than Active, preventing custom chrome rendering
findings.issue: The Author page includes both XF wrappers but neither custom header nor footer renders. Each XF contains an HTL compilation exception resolving SiteHeaderModel/SiteFooterModel.
findings.evidence: Author bundles.json reports bundle 653 ‘ADLC Crowdstrike - Core’ state Installed. GET About page: header=0, footer=0, and exception ‘SiteHeaderModel cannot be resolved to a type’.
findings.cause: The application bundle has unresolved runtime activation/dependency state; package creation and unit tests do not prove OSGi activation.
findings.recommendation: Inspect bundle 653’s unresolved imports/activation diagnostics, correct the core bundle manifest/dependency issue, deploy, and verify the bundle is Active plus one rendered header/footer on Author and Publish.

findings.title: Local Publish endpoint is unavailable
findings.issue: Publish route validation could not run.
findings.cause: No local Publish process is listening on 4503.
findings.recommendation: Start/configure local Publish before rerunning tier-specific validation.

callout.text: The passing generic integration suite does not override the direct rendered-page failure. This run is not promotable.
